basic_details.short_information: Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU) will hold a walk-in interview for 1 post of Teaching Associate in the Department of Agricultural Extension, Agricultural College, Pulivendula on 7 November 2026 from 10.30 AM. Candidates must register their names before 9.30 AM at the Office of Associate Dean, Agricultural College, Pulivendula, with a filled-in application, all original certificates and one set of photocopies. The post is purely temporary and contractual, for a period not exceeding 11 months. This is a rescheduled walk-in interview notice.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women. The notice does not mention the date on which age is counted or any age relaxation.

qualification.details: One post of Teaching Associate is to be filled in the Department of Agricultural Extension. The essential qualifications are printed in the notice as follows: | a) Ph.D. in the relevant subject or b) Master's Degree in relevant subject c) Bachelor's Degree of 4/5 years having first division or equivalent overall grade point average d) Experience for at least 3 years in respective teaching/ research experience as evidenced from Fellowship/ Associateship/ Training/ other engagements e) Published one research paper in Science Citation Index (SCI)/ NAAS rated ≥ 4.0 journals f) Candidates having post graduate degree in Basic Sciences with 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree should have the NET qualification | For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification. | The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women. The notice does not mention the date on which age is counted or any age relaxation. | HRA will be given as per the existing State Government rates applicable in various places/locations and is subject to change from time to time as per Government orders. | The post is purely temporary, on a contractual basis, for a period not exceeding 11 months. The tenure is 11 months from the date of joining or until the filling of the regular post, whichever is earlier.

selection_process: Selection is through a walk-in interview held at Agricultural College

Pulivendula on 7 November 2026 from 10.30 AM. The decision of the selection committee for the post will be final and binding in all respects. Selected candidates will be required to undergo a medical examination at their own expense
to ensure their physical fitness before appointment.
how_to_apply: There is no postal or email application for this post. Candidates attend the walk-in interview in person:
Reach the Office of Associate Dean, Agricultural College, Pulivendula on 7 November 2026.
Hand in the filled-in application along with all original certificates and one set of photocopies of all certificates, publications and any other relevant documents.
Appear for the interview, which starts at 10.30 AM at Agricultural College, Pulivendula.
The notice asks for a "filled-in application" but does not attach an application form or say where a form can be obtained.
important_instructions: The engagement will be terminated automatically after completion of 11 months or the filling of regular staff by the university, whichever is earlier. The person engaged shall have no claim to any regular appointment in the University or any government organisation, and no right to further continuation of contractual service. Concealing facts or canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification at the time of selection or termination even during the contractual engagement period. The contractual engagement can be terminated at any time without prior notice or assigning any reason. The person engaged may leave the contractual service by giving one month's notice; otherwise one month's salary must be paid before leaving. No T.A. and D.A. will be given to candidates appearing for the interview. The Associate Dean of the college has the right to cancel or postpone the interview for the said date due to any unavoidable circumstances. A copy of the notice was sent for posting on the ANGRAU website.

content_sections.heading: About ANGRAU Agricultural College, Pulivendula
content_sections.text: Agricultural College, Pulivendula is a college of Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU), located on the APCARL Campus, Pulivendula, YSR District, Andhra Pradesh – 516391. The notice is issued by the Associate Dean of the college, and the post is in the college's Department of Agricultural Extension.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Apply
content_sections.text: There is no postal or email application for this post. Candidates attend the walk-in interview in person: Reach the Office of Associate Dean, Agricultural College, Pulivendula on 7 November 2026. Register your name before 9.30 AM. Hand in the filled-in application along with all original certificates and one set of photocopies of all certificates, publications and any other relevant documents. Appear for the interview, which starts at 10.30 AM at Agricultural College, Pulivendula. The notice asks for a "filled-in application" but does not attach an application form or say where a form can be obtained.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: One post of Teaching Associate is to be filled in the Department of Agricultural Extension. The essential qualifications are printed in the notice as follows: a) Ph.D. in the relevant subject or b) Master's Degree in relevant subject c) Bachelor's Degree of 4/5 years having first division or equivalent overall grade point average d) Experience for at least 3 years in respective teaching/ research experience as evidenced from Fellowship/ Associateship/ Training/ other engagements e) Published one research paper in Science Citation Index (SCI)/ NAAS rated ≥ 4.0 journals f) Candidates having post graduate degree in Basic Sciences with 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree should have the NET qualification For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification. The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women. The notice does not mention the date on which age is counted or any age relaxation. HRA will be given as per the existing State Government rates applicable in various places/locations and is subject to change from time to time as per Government orders. The post is purely temporary, on a contractual basis, for a period not exceeding 11 months. The tenure is 11 months from the date of joining or until the filling of the regular post, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview held at Agricultural College, Pulivendula on 7 November 2026 from 10.30 AM. The decision of the selection committee for the post will be final and binding in all respects. Selected candidates will be required to undergo a medical examination at their own expense, as per the rules, to ensure their physical fitness before appointment.

No T.A. and D.A. will be given to candidates appearing for the interview. faq.question: Q1. How many Teaching Associate posts are being filled at Agricultural College, Pulivendula?
faq.answer: One post (01 No.) of Teaching Associate is being filled in the Department of Agricultural Extension.

faq.question: Q2. When is the ANGRAU Teaching Associate walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 7 November 2026 from 10.30 AM at Agricultural College, Pulivendula, and candidates must register their names before 9.30 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the ANGRAU Teaching Associate post?
faq.answer: The notice lists Ph.D. in the relevant subject or Master's Degree in relevant subject, a 4/5-year Bachelor's Degree with first division or equivalent OGPA, at least 3 years of teaching/research experience, one research paper in SCI/NAAS rated ≥ 4.0 journals, and NET for post graduates in Basic Sciences with a 3-year Bachelor's and 2-year Master's degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ANGRAU Teaching Associate post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an ANGRAU Teaching Associate?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 61,000/- + applicable HRA per month for Master's Degree holders and Rs. 67,000/- + applicable HRA per month for Ph.D. Degree holders.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Teaching Associate pay?
faq.answer: Yes, applicable HRA is paid in addition, at the existing State Government rates for the place of posting, subject to change as per Government orders.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the ANGRAU Teaching Associate post?
faq.answer: Register your name before 9.30 AM on 7 November 2026 at the Office of Associate Dean, Agricultural College, Pulivendula, with a filled-in application, all original certificates and one set of photocopies of all certificates, publications and other relevant documents.

faq.question: Q8. How is the ANGRAU Teaching Associate selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through the walk-in interview, and the decision of the selection committee is final and binding in all respects.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ANGRAU Teaching Associate post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is purely temporary and contractual for a period not exceeding 11 months, ending earlier if the regular post is filled, with no claim to regular appointment.

faq.answer: No, the notice states that no T.A. and D.A. will be given to candidates appearing for the interview.
